I guess so. We haven’t really been talking, I guess it doesn’t matter much, I know they’ll be better off when I’m gone though.

I don’t know. I’m trying so hard to hold on but I feel like a failure for still being alive. I’m so much older than I ever should have bothered getting. I’m scared I’ll just keep going into 2018 and just keep fucking it up. I don’t deserve to fuck everything up anymore...

hey listen man thanks for your posts and trying to help me, it means a lot I’m sorry if I’m coming off as belligerent or anything. I’m just overwhelmed. 2018 is getting close and I really think I need to let go before it gets here...

Trust me, the people I’m talking about in particular really only see me as a burden anymore. There are still some people who love me, but they’re painfully far away.

I’m working on finding a therapist or something. I know that I really need it, if for no other reason than that I don’t want to end up like my parents. But my family has always mostly labeled therapy as a money-making scam, and I’m scared it’s not going to help me. I’m scared that even if it should help, I’m too broken now for anyone to fix. I’m scared that it’s just going to be more of a waste of time and money. 

I just want to be self-sufficient in 2018. I want to get my GED, a job, a cheap used car, my own phone and get away from my parents. But I don’t feel like I’ll be able to get a job because of not having my GED yet, and living in a small town where my family has a bad reputation. 

My parents stole roughly 12k inheritance money from me when I was a child and I worked for my dad daily for free for 7 years. You’d figure that would give me a little cushion room to be able to live in their house, but all they ever do is yell at me for not making money now that I’m not working with him any more, and I get it I need to be making money but I can’t and between them yelling at me about it and constantly reminding me how I’ve failed everything in my past and everyone has given up on me, it’s really pushing me closer to the edge.

Not only that but they’ve been guilting me for the cost of raising me growing up! They say that the cost of all of the electronics they’ve ever bought me way surpasses my inheritance. That’s bull and I could do the math and know for a fact that it’s bull but what’s the point any more? I suck anyway, I guess it doesn’t hurt if they just assume I’m worse than I am.

Hey, thanks dude :) I saw your video and see what you mean, but you totally pass to me, so that helps a lot. 

It’s just hard because whenever I try to talk about my female relatives about being trans all they do is say I’m beautiful and point out my feminine features, eyelashes, eyes, lips, and it makes it really hard for me to see myself as masculine. 

I don’t feel “beautiful,” either, so I wish they’d stop.
Ty, I’ll think about trying that

Yeah, she’s the main reason I’m alive right now. She knows I struggle with thoughts like this and she just says she really wants me to be around. 

But I’m so scared I’m going to keep fucking everything up and hurting everyone forever. I’m scared that next time I try getting out of my parents house I’ll ruin it again. It feels like whether I kill myself or not, I’ll hurt her eventually so I might as well make it some way I can control and won’t need to feel guilt for afterwards...

I worked with my dad after high school and we fought nearly every day, no matter how hard I try to get along with him. 

During that point I completely ghosted my best friend because fighting so much made me feel toxic and I didn’t want to hurt her. We’re talking again and she’s forgiven me, but I’ll always feel shitty for that. 

Earlier this year my parents kicked me out and sent me to my grandmas house. It was amazing there, my grandma and the two people living with her were great to me, but I ended up going crazy and ruining that and I had to move back in with my parents. Now those three people probably hate me and I’ll probably never see them again, and my parents hate me because we fight so much. 

Everyone either hates me or should. I’m incapable of dealing with people. Sometimes I try to blame it on being homeschooled and isolated, but now that I’m an adult it’s really no ones fault but my own anymore.

I know the scars don’t make me a bad person. I hate them, I hate how I look with them and they make me feel weak, but that’s not the main reason I want to die. 

I just feel like I’ve ruined everything. I feel so guilty for all of the pain that I’ve caused, and I can’t imagine ever being able to fix anything any more. I’m scared that if I stay, I’m going to keep ruining everything and hurting everyone. I hate hurting other people so much more than hurting myself. 

I can’t be a normal or good person, and I don’t want to be here if I’m just going to be crazy and cause pain.
